sentences.text: Today we will talk about Jordan.
Jordan is a beautiful country in the Middle East.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Where is Jordan?
Jordan is Western Asia in the Middle East.
It is next to Israel, Palestine, Syria, Iraq, and Saudi Arabia.
It also has a small coast on the Red Sea.
Jordan has deserts, mountains, cities, and ancient places.
What is the capital city of Jordan?
The capital city is Amman.
Amman is the largest city in Jordan.
It is modern and busy.
It has shops, restaurants, schools, and old ruins.
Amman is built on many hills.
It is a mix of old and new.
How many people live in Jordan?
About 11 million people live in Jordan.
Most people live in cities like Amman, Zarka, and Erbid.
Some people live in villages or in the desert.
Jordan is also home to many refugees from other countries.
What language do people speak in Jordan?
People speak Arabic in Jordan.
Arabic is the official language.
Many people also speak English, especially in schools and businesses.
English is taught from a young age.
What is the weather like in Jordan?
Jordan has hot summers and cool winters.
In summer, it is very dry and sunny.
In winter, it can be cold and sometimes it snows in the north.
The country has little rain, mostly in the winter months.
The south and east are desert areas.
What does Jordan look like?
Jordan has many different landscapes, mountains in the west, deserts in the east and south, the Dead Sea in the west, green valleys in the north.
One famous place is Wadi Room, a large red desert with beautiful rocks.
Another is Petra, an ancient city with buildings carved in stone.
What animals live in Jordan?
In Jordan, you can find camels, goats, foxes, eagles, hyenas, snakes and lizards in the desert.
Camels are strong animals used for transport in the desert.
In farms, people raise sheep, chickens and cows.
What do people eat in Jordan?
Jordanian food is tasty and full of flavor.
People eat rice, bread and meat, lentils, chickpeas and yogurt, vegetables and olive oil.
Popular dishes include monsuf, the national dish made with lamb rice and yogurt sauce, makluba rice, meat and vegetables cooked upside down.
Falafel, fried balls made from chickpeas.
Hummus, mashed chickpeas with lemon and oil.
Tabula, salad with parsley, tomato and bulgur.
For dessert, people enjoy baklava, dates and kanafa.
What do people drink in Jordan?
People drink tea and coffee.
Tea is often with mint or sugar.
Coffee is strong and sometimes has cardamom, a spice.
People also drink fruit juice, yogurt drinks and water.
What is life like in Jordan?
Life in Jordan is a mix of modern and traditional.
People go to school and work during the week.
Weekends are for family time, rest and fun.
Family is very important in Jordan.
People often live close to their parents and relatives.
In the cities there are cafes, malls and museums.
In the villages, life is slower and more connected to nature.
What are some holidays and traditions in Jordan?
People in Jordan celebrate.
Eid al -Fitr at the end of Ramadan.
Eid al -Adha, the feast of sacrifice.
Independence Day on May 25th.
Christmas, celebrated by Christians.
During holidays, people wear nice clothes, visit family and share food.
Jordanian music uses drums, ood and voices.
People also enjoy dobki, a traditional dance with fast steps.
Some fun facts about Jordan Petra is one of the new seven wonders of the world.
The Dead Sea is the lowest place on earth.
You can float in the water easily.
Jordan is one of the safest countries in the Middle East.
The flag of Jordan is black, white, green and red with a white star.
Jordan is known for hospitality.
Guests are treated with kindness and respect.
Now you know many things about Jordan.
You know where it is, what people speak and how they live.
You learned about the food, nature and culture.
Great job.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English podcast.
I am Emily.
